name: marketing
description: A business agent that turns a campaign idea into a checked draft and schedules it only after a named reviewer has approved that exact version for a date.

connection.instructions: In Mailchimp, open your profile, then **Extras**, then **API keys**, and create a key. Copy it and paste it below. It ends in a data-centre suffix such as `-us21`.

fields.name: MAILCHIMP_API_KEY
fields.label: Mailchimp API key
fields.helpText: Found under Profile, Extras, API keys in Mailchimp. Include the data-centre suffix.

outcomes: Every campaign is checked for claims, spend and timing before a reviewer sees it
Nothing is scheduled until a reviewer approves that exact version for a date
Each published campaign has a publication receipt on file
agent.priceDisplay: Illustrative: from $129 per workspace per month
agent.usageDisplay: Illustrative: up to 20 campaigns a month included
